demonstration.narration: I'll open the records behind the spike, with the same filter and window, to see what the failing requests share.
demonstration.reasoning: A spike is only a count. The records behind it show whether the failures share one route and one error, or are just noise.
demonstration.evidence: This record behind the spike is a ${truth.finding} request to ${truth.scope} that failed with CheckoutStateConflict. It is in the same window and filter as the chart. ${truth.conclusion}
